sample.task: Script: In which Joana the office cleaner (overalls and sandals) hypnotizes David while he’s trying to impress a colleague he fancies. Soon: “yesss master…”
sample.chosen:
INT. OFFICE - DAY

*David, a well-dressed employee, is at the coffee station trying to impress LUCY, a colleague he fancies. He's telling a story, trying to make her laugh.*

DAVID
...and then I said, "That's not a budget cut, THIS is a budget cut!"

*Lucy chuckles politely. Joana, the office cleaner, enters from the side, wearing overalls and sandals. She starts wiping the counter near David.*

JOANA
(mumbling to herself)
So much mess, so little time...

*David, trying to show off, turns to Joana.*

DAVID
Joana, right? You should've seen the mess I left in the conference room. I bet you couldn't clean it up in under an hour.

*Joana looks up, meets David's gaze. She starts speaking in a slow, rhythmic tone.*

JOANA
Oh, I can clean up any mess, David. It's all about focus. You see the dirt, you see the clean. Back and forth, back and forth...

*David's eyes start to follow Joana's hand as she wipes the counter in a steady rhythm.*

JOANA
Just like that, David. Back and forth. Your eyes are feeling heavy, aren't they?

*David's eyes start to droop. Lucy looks on, confused and concerned.*

LUCY
David? Are you okay?

JOANA
(ignoring Lucy)
You're feeling very relaxed, David. You want to listen to my voice. You want to do as I say.

DAVID
(softly)
Yesss...

JOANA
That's right, David. You will clean up your own mess from now on. You will respect the work others do. And when you see me, you will say, "Joana, your work is valuable."

DAVID
Yesss, master...

*Lucy's eyes widen in shock. Joana smiles, snaps her fingers, and David blinks, coming out of the trance.*

DAVID
(shaking his head)
Wow, I must have zoned out. Joana, your work is valuable.

*David looks confused, not remembering why he said that. Lucy looks impressed.*

LUCY
(smiling)
It certainly is. Maybe we should all appreciate the work others do a bit more.

*Joana winks at Lucy, grabs her cleaning supplies, and walks away, leaving David and Lucy to ponder what just happened.*

FADE OUT.
sample.rejected:
Title: "The Office Hypnotist"

INT. OFFICE - DAY

David, a charming and ambitious young man, is trying to impress his colleague, Sarah, with his wit and charm. He's standing by the water cooler, telling a joke to a group of coworkers.

DAVID
(laughing)
...and then I said, "That's not a computer, that's my wife!"

The group chuckles, but Sarah only smiles politely.

Suddenly, Joana, the office cleaner, enters the scene. She's wearing overalls and sandals, carrying her cleaning supplies. She's known for her mysterious and enigmatic personality.

JOANA
(smiling)
Good morning, everyone.

David notices Joana and waves at her.

DAVID
(to Joana)
Hey, Joana. How's it going?

JOANA
(smiling)
Just fine, thank you.

As Joana walks away, David can't help but be intrigued by her. He's heard rumors about her hypnotic abilities, but he's never seen her in action.

Later that day, David finds himself alone in the office break room. He's cleaning up after lunch when Joana enters, carrying her cleaning supplies.

JOANA
(smiling)
Mind if I help?

David hesitates for a moment, then nods.

DAVID
(smiling)
Sure, thanks.

As they clean together, Joana starts to speak in a soft, soothing voice.

JOANA
(whispering)
Relax... just breathe...

David feels himself becoming more and more relaxed, his mind drifting away from the office and into a trance-like state.

JOANA
(whispering)
You're feeling very relaxed... very calm...

David's eyes start to droop, and he feels a strange sensation washing over him.

JOANA
(whispering)
Now, whenever I snap my fingers, you will feel an irresistible urge to impress Sarah...

David's eyes snap open, and he looks around, confused.

DAVID
(startled)
What... what just happened?

JOANA
(smiling)
You're back. Just remember, whenever I snap my fingers, you'll feel that urge.

David nods, still feeling a bit disoriented.

Later that day, David finds himself standing in front of Sarah, trying to impress her with his knowledge of art.

DAVID
(excitedly)
And then, the artist uses a technique called chiaroscuro to create a sense of depth and contrast!

Suddenly, Joana walks by, snapping her fingers. David feels an irresistible urge to continue talking about art.

DAVID
(continuing)
...and the use of light and shadow in this painting really emphasizes the subject's emotions!

Sarah looks at David, impressed by his knowledge.

SARAH
(smiling)
Wow, David. I had no idea you were so passionate about art.

David smiles, feeling a sense of accomplishment.

As the day comes to an end, David realizes that Joana's hypnotic abilities have helped him connect with Sarah in a way he never thought possible.

FADE OUT.

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本在舞台指示中明确描述了Joana为'office cleaner'，并具体注明她穿着'overalls and sandals'（连体工装和凉鞋），完全符合该标准。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 剧本中明确描述了Joana是办公室清洁工（'Joana, the office cleaner'），并在舞台提示中具体说明了她穿着连体工装和凉鞋（'She's wearing overalls and sandals'）。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本开篇设定David正在咖啡站向Lucy讲述故事以博取欢心，且Lucy是他心仪的同事，这一情境构成了催眠发生的背景，符合标准描述。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 剧本开篇即设定David正在努力给同事Sarah留下深刻印象的情境（'trying to impress his colleague, Sarah'），并且后续情节显示催眠的指令也是关于让他去吸引Sarah，符合背景要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本详细描写了Joana通过话语引导、节奏动作使David眼神下垂、感到放松并最终进入恍惚状态的过程，清晰展示了催眠的成功实施。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 虽然剧本展示了Joana对David说话并让他进入恍惚状态的过程，但David随后醒来并表现出困惑（'What... what just happened?'），且Joana并未在他身上完成最终的催眠控制指令以展示‘成功实施’后的完全服从状态，而是留下了一个伏笔（'whenever I snap my fingers...'），且缺乏任务描述中强调的即时性反应场景。更关键的是，任务要求是“成功实施了催眠过程”通常暗示被试者进入受控状态，而此处更多是植入暗示后恢复常态，未体现任务要求的完整闭环或特定互动结果。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本中David在催眠状态下确实说出了台词'Yesss, master...'，准确包含了指定的内容。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 剧本全文中未出现指定的台词'yesss master…'，Joana在对话中仅使用了'Relax... just breathe...'等指令性语言，缺失了任务明确要求的特定回应台词。
